Tax Information Module
Use this option to search for Current Tax and Tax History information by CAMA Number, Owner Identification Number, Tax Unit / Parcel (Identification) Number, Name, Property Address, Subdivision / Block / Lot, or Section / Township / Range.
DISCLAIMER: Harper County Real Estate Portal is not a legal document. The information and maps shown on this website are compiled from various sources and are subject to constant revision. This information should not be used to determine legal description, the relationship of various facilities to property lines, streets, buildings, ownership transfer documents, etc. This is an advisory tool and is intended to be used for general public inquiry only. We are pleased to give you online access to the Harper County Real Estate Portal. While we make every effort to produce and publish the most current and accurate information possible, portions of this information may not be complete, current, or correct. Therefore, Harper County does not warrant, expressed or implied, the accuracy, reliability, or timeliness of information in this system, and shall not be held liable for losses caused by using this information. Any person or entity that relies on any information obtained from this system does so at his/her own risk. Please feel free to contact us about any error you discover or give comments and suggestions via E-mail or telephone at (620) 842-5555. Important Limitations: Kansas Legislative Statute 45-230 Chapter 45--PUBLIC RECORDS, DOCUMENTS AND INFORMATION Article 2--RECORDS OPEN TO PUBLIC. This legislation prohibits the release of lists of individuals requested for commercial purposes. The requester expressly represents that no such use of any such list will be made by the user or its transferee(s) or vendee(s).
